title: Non-Riso Lesson – Create Lesson – Non-Riso org – Lesson Name not auto-generated
description: AC 04.1 — Regression — On a non-Riso org, creating a lesson does not auto-generate Lesson Name; the field remains blank or retains only the manually entered value.
preconditions: Logged in as HQ or CM Staff to a non-Riso Salesforce org\nAccess to the Lesson creation form on the non-Riso org
steps_actions:
1. Navigate to Lessons on the non-Riso org and click New Lesson
2. Select a Subject if Subject field is available on this org
3. Fill required fields and click Save
4. Open the new lesson detail page
5. Observe the Lesson Name field
steps_result:
1. Lesson creation form opens
2. Subject set (or field absent)
3. Lesson saved
4. Lesson detail loads
5. Lesson Name is not auto-generated; it is blank or shows only the manually entered value — the [Subject] - [Course] format is not applied

title: [Riso] Lesson – Create Lesson – HQ Staff and CM Staff – Both roles can create lesson with auto-generated name
description: AC 04.2 — Permission Matrix (Smoke) — No new permission required; HQ Staff and CM Staff can both create Riso lessons and receive the auto-generated Lesson Name.
preconditions: Access to the Riso Salesforce org under both HQ Staff role and CM Staff role\nSubject Biology exists in Subject Master
steps_actions:
1. Log in as HQ Staff to the Riso SF org
2. Navigate to Lessons and click New Lesson
3. Set Teaching Method = Individual, Subject = Biology, leave Course blank; fill required fields and click Save
4. Observe the Lesson Name field
5. Log out and log in as CM Staff to the Riso SF org
6. Navigate to Lessons and click New Lesson
7. Set Teaching Method = Individual, Subject = Biology, leave Course blank; fill required fields and click Save
8. Observe the Lesson Name field
steps_result:
1. Logged in as HQ Staff; lesson management is accessible
2. Lesson creation form opens without a permission error
3. Lesson saved without access denied or permission error
4. Lesson Name = Biology (auto-generated)
5. Logged in as CM Staff
6. Lesson creation form opens without a permission error
7. Lesson saved without access denied or permission error
8. Lesson Name = Biology (auto-generated)
